summary: {analyst} explains why the number of hearing-aid complaints cannot tell a committee how often buyers are hurt.
realLife: FDA told GAO it had received twelve adverse-event reports by February 2024 and that a system reliant on people reporting problems would miss some experiences.
inGame: needs: complaint records, reporting method and exposure data.

turns.pulledBy: A member asks what fraction of buyers had problems.
turns.what: Staff checks the source of the count.
turns.writesBack: The analyst identifies the missing usage and reporting data.

turns.pulledBy: A member asks what the reported problems were.
turns.what: The committee requests examples from the reports.
turns.writesBack: The analyst can describe the reports without estimating a population rate.
